physical.objective_constraint: flatSearchCutoff represents a threshold for allowList.Len() comparison (search.go line 86: allowList.Len() < flatSearchCutoff). As a threshold for comparing with unsigned quantity (list length), it semantically should be non-negative. Negative value -100 makes the comparison always false, breaking the intended search strategy selection logic.

behavioral.note: API gracefully accepts negative value without error, storing and returning it. However, this graceful handling masks a semantic bug: the negative value will cause search.go line 86 condition (allowList.Len() < flatSearchCutoff) to always evaluate to FALSE, effectively disabling flat search optimization. Source code shows no by-design intent to accept negative values for this threshold parameter.
